layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Brief outline on CSR Policy of the Company

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: At Tata Technologies, our Corporate Sustainability vision is to co-create sustainable value for our key stakeholders through

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: engineering and technology innovation. Our mission is to make a positive impact on the communities where the company does

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: business and on our internal and external stakeholders by enhancing the quality of life, committing to environmental enrichment

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and fostering innovation. Thereby, making it better for the planet, better for people, better for progress, better now and better for the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: future. We shall strategicall integrate the endeavour to achieve operational sustainability with societal development by leveraging

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: our core competencies, resources, technology and employee volunteers. We shall be proactive towards the welfare of our key

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: stakeholders – the underprivileged and marginalized communities, socially and economically disadvantaged groups and the society
